## What this repo covers
- IP geolocation concepts for ecommerce (localization, compliance, analytics, fraud context)
- Proxy/VPN intelligence concepts (VPN/proxy detection, residential proxy considerations)
- Ecommerce decisioning patterns: allow / challenge / block
- Field dictionary templates and machine-readable schemas (vendor-neutral)
